written_before: any read of a triggered or clean-test score of the Swin-S middle band by experiments/final_method/fusion_readout.py
what_was_read_before: Only clean-validation shift ratios, to count which Swin panel models hold a complete pre_residual_blocks_9_16 ladder and whether it reaches the adaptive target. 63 of the 65 successful Swin-S panel models (scripts.paper.tab_swin.swin_cells) hold the full 11-rate ladder from an earlier sweep, swin_cifar10_tact_0_01 and swin_cifar10_tact_0_05 do not. No detection number of the band was computed.
set: swin_panel: scripts.paper.tab_swin.swin_cells(results, checkpoints), the successful_2pt Swin-S cells, read once after the 2 missing ladders are swept

method.band_reason: Swin-S has 24 blocks in 4 stages of 2, 2, 18 and 2. cli.sweep --block-range indexes them 1 to 24 in forward order across stages (models.positions.resolve_targets), so the middle third is blocks 9 to 16, all inside stage 3 (features.5.4 to features.5.11). The ViT band pre_residual_blocks_5_8 is the middle third of 12 blocks.

rules.min: min of the 2 clean-validation percentiles (fusion_rules min_rank)
rules.average: mean of the 2 fractional PSUs (fusion_rules mean_psu)

method.reference: PSBD-TM alone on the same models
method.thresholds: quantile of each score's own clean-validation distribution, realized FPR read on the paired clean test split

predictions.text: under the min rule mean TPR at 1%, 5% and 10% nominal FPR is above PSBD-TM alone at each of the 3 FPRs
under the average rule mean TPR at 1%, 5% and 10% nominal FPR is above PSBD-TM alone at each of the 3 FPRs

reporting: Paired bootstrap 95% intervals over models (scripts.paper._common.bootstrap_ci, 5000 resamples, seed 0), AUROC beside TPR, per-attack means, and the models where a placement does not reach the adaptive target listed by name. A positive mean whose interval includes 0 is reported as not confirmed.
